_about: The 3D people to make (scripts/assets/people3d/make-cast.mjs; docs/SPECTATOR-ART.md). Each: id, root (art/people3d: townspeople, they walk the town; art/spectators: the tournament's spectators and staff), role, height (m), from (the base person whose rig and clips are moved onto it), look (the RUN prompt: its first words must differ from every other look's, so a model is found in RUN's library after the CLI's timeout). render: how every person is rendered (the owner's choice, 2026-10-23: hands B, arms in). Optional per person: image (an A-pose picture: the model is made from it, image-to-3d; golfers and remakes, 2026-10-24), clips (more base clips moved on and rendered, e.g. golf_drive), render (overrides the global render settings). art/golfers: the golfers (golf_drive: the swing, with a club the render adds). clipRender: the render options of each extra clip; runClips: other names RUN may know a clip by (golf_drive is id 323 in the Meshy animation library RUN uses).
